# Solar Studio — illustration reference

Design revision: 2.0.0 · schema containers-hamlet-design/v2.0 · design hash 1bfe2c66

This description is generated from the canonical design model. The reference SVG is the authoritative geometric reference. The illustration prompt is an interpretation.

## Architectural facts
- 1 occupied storey
- 2 container modules (20ft, 20ft)
- solar-ready roof at 12 degrees
- 29.5 m2 gross floor area
- 29.5 m2 ground coverage
- 4.92 m to the roof

## Modules
- **m1** — storey 1, 6.058 × 2.438 m, base 0.6 m, rotation 0°, timber cladding.
- **m2** — storey 1, 6.058 × 2.438 m, base 0.6 m, rotation 0°, metal cladding.

## Openings
- m1 / Living doors — south sliding-door, 2 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / Living window — south window, 0.95 × 1.3 m, sill 0.9 m.
- m1 / Kitchen window — north window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 1.1 m.
- m1 / Bathroom window — west window, 0.8 × 1 m, sill 1.4 m.
- m1 / Entry door — east door, 0.95 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m2 / Studio glazing — south window, 2.4 × 1.6 m, sill 0.6 m.
- m2 / Studio window — north window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 0.9 m.
- m2 / Workshop door — east door, 0.9 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m2 / Garden door — south door, 0.95 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.

## Rooms and zones
- m1 / Living — living, 0–2.8 m. Compact ground-floor living; verify a 1.5 m turning space.
- m1 / Kitchen — kitchen, 2.8–4.2 m. Compact kitchen; verify clear approach.
- m1 / Bathroom — bathroom, 4.2–5.2 m. Ground-floor bathroom; adaptable layout target.
- m1 / Stair — circulation, 5.2–6 m. Compact stair; not step-free to the upper studio.
- m2 / Studio — work, 0–3.4 m. Upper studio; stair only.
- m2 / Sleeping — sleeping, 3.4–6 m. Upper sleeping; stair only.

## Outdoor spaces
- p1: 4.4 × 2.4 m covered porch on the north face of m1.
- p2: 2.4 × 1.4 m covered porch on the south face of m2.

## Site and camera
- Assigned site: Cabin F (site rotation 80°).
- Principal view: The southern cove of Heron Lake through juniper and cedar, with the opposite shore close enough to read the rock.
- Path approach: north-east
- Camera: exterior three-quarter view, 1.6 m, 35 mm, bearing 295°.

## Interior schedule
- Living (living) — 6.11 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Kitchen (kitchen) — 2.9 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Bathroom (bathroom) — 1.98 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Stair (circulation) — 1.52 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Studio (work) — 7.49 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Sleeping (sleeping) — 5.65 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Partitions: 0 · doors: 0 · fixtures: 0.
- Validation: 0 invalid, 9 unresolved, 6 review.

## Intentions
- Step-free entrance is a design intent, not a verified measurement.
- Adaptable bathroom is a design intent, not a verified layout.
- Adaptable kitchen is a design intent, not a verified layout.

## Unresolved matters
- **interior-partitions**: Rooms are longitudinal zones. Partitions, fixtures, door swings and interior camera geometry are not modeled. Do not claim a spatially accurate interior perspective.
- **provisional-interior**: Interior geometry is provisional. Partitions, doors and fixtures may be incomplete.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z1 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z2 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z3 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m1-m1-z4 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m2-m2-z1 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **inferred-room**: Room room-m2-m2-z2 is inferred from a zone band, not an authored layout.
- **room-coverage**: Room polygons cover less than 55% of the clear interior. Unassigned floor area may be unresolved.
- **doors-missing**: No interior doors are modeled. Room connectivity cannot be assessed.

## Capability notes
- Exterior reference: available
- Interior perspective: not available — no interior camera or perspective renderer is implemented
- Room-zone plan: available
- Roof plan: available
